notes:
Nashama TV iOS v1.1.8:
- Fixed channel/poster logos not loading (scheme-relative icon URLs from some Xtream panels were silently failing to load).
- Fixed live channel playback taking a long time to start.
- Fixed Live TV tab being slow to open with large channel lists.
- Favorites screen now matches the Android app: 3 tabs (Live/Movies/Series), remove with confirmation, per-series notification toggle, per-tab empty states.
- Live/Movies/Series sort menus now match Android's options (Server Order, Name A-Z/Z-A, Year, etc).
- Attempted fix for a rotation/layout bug after leaving the live player on iOS 15 devices.
- Install with Sideloadly or xtool using your Apple ID; re-sideload every 7 days to keep it signed.
